sources.summary: EA House is a family home carefully crafted onto a sensitive rock cliff face escarpment in the southern highlands. A simple elemental gesture testing emotional responses on a difficult and unique site. An experimental house, while simple in form, solves many overlapping constraints and challenges that exist because of the site. A leftover parcel of land from a suburb that was planned before realizing there was a giant cliff & gorge. Since being deemed unbuildable, the site has been empty ever since.
